## Executive Summary

Scale Flow is an independent web design and full-stack development studio headquartered in Connaught Place, New Delhi. Rather than relying on pre-made themes or generic site builders, Scale Flow engineers bespoke websites and web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Three.js/WebGL, and Node.js/MySQL).

## Engineering & Design Capabilities

1. **Custom Frontend Architecture**: Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and server-side rendering (SSR) for clean semantic HTML and strong Core Web Vitals on mobile and desktop.
2. **WCAG Accessibility & Semantic Structure**: Full keyboard navigation, ARIA landmarks, descriptive action labels, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
3. **3D & Interactive Motion**: Custom WebGL/Three.js product showcases and GPU-composited GSAP + ScrollTrigger choreography.
4. **E-Commerce & Payment Readiness**: Support for Indian and international payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, Stripe, UPI), product catalogs, and WhatsApp order flows.

## Service Packages & Pricing (INR)

All packages can be customized with individual functional add-ons in the [Website Cost Calculator](https://www.joinscaleflow.in/build-your-website):
- **Basic / Starter Website**: Starting at ₹15,000
- **Business Growth Website**: Starting at ₹30,000
- **Premium / 3D Interactive Website**: Starting at ₹45,000+
- **E-Commerce Storefront**: Custom itemized estimate based on catalog and checkout features
